content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electronic instruments and motors for test, process and industrial customers, not custom foam, plastic or composite components."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Industrial valves, pumps and aerospace parts; its composite panels are a small overlap, not custom precision components for OEMs."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies and test equipment; it resells products rather than manufacturing custom components."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes electronic components and fasteners from stock; it does not design or manufacture custom components."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting consumables, equipment and automation for fabricators and shipyards; different products and customers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor selling to contractors through branches; not a custom component manufacturer."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and seals with plant service for process industries; different products and end markets."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Contract designs and manufactures medical device components for OEMs under customer specifications, matching UFP's medical component business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, friction products and connectors for industrial and rail markets; different products from UFP's molded and foam components."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking and wood processing equipment sold to mills and plants; different products and customers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Metalworking tools and MRO supplies distributed through catalogs and branches; a distributor, not a component maker."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes metal locks, hinges and castings for industrial and vehicle customers; different materials and end markets from foam and plastic components."}]}
